changes.incidentTitle: Tensorlake: attacker reached engineering GitHub via vendor-hosted sandboxes after unrotated env vars
changes.title: Tensorlake founder Diptanu Choudhury discloses a security incident: an internal application on an upstream provider spun up sandboxes in engineering-team accounts that had access to Tensorlake GitHub repositories; an attacker pushed malicious code to branches and triggered GitHub Actions to probe workflow secrets.

changes.incidentTitle: Tensorlake: attacker reached engineering GitHub via vendor-hosted sandboxes after unrotated env vars
changes.title: The same post says there was no impact to customer API keys or sandboxes, no evidence that critical systems were accessed beyond secret probing, that Tensorlake rotated all secrets and undeployed the internal application, emailed paying customers, and asks all customers to rotate Tensorlake API keys. Later edits add that the upstream provider had a security breach a couple of weeks earlier that exposed environment variables, that Tensorlake had not rotated those env vars because the app was not critical for production, and that this was an oversight. The first published version named the provider as Railway.

changes.incidentTitle: UnrealIRCd before 6.2.7.1: any normal user can run commands with server/IRCOp authority (critical CVE-2026-114713) plus 8 more fixes
changes.title: MITRE publishes CVE-2026-114713 (CVSS 3.1 8.6): the labeled-response module does not escape the IRCv3 label tag, letting any user on a network with two or more linked servers inject server-to-server commands executed with server authority.

changes.incidentTitle: UnrealIRCd before 6.2.7.1: any normal user can run commands with server/IRCOp authority (critical CVE-2026-114713) plus 8 more fixes
changes.title: UnrealIRCd releases 6.2.7.1 and hot-patch bundle-20261107 fixing 9 security issues, including critical CVE-2026-114713 (normal users can execute commands with server/IRCOp authority), and publishes a SPAMFILTER workaround that protects networks whose servers are all on 6.0.4 or newer.

changes.incidentTitle: UnrealIRCd before 6.2.7.1: any normal user can run commands with server/IRCOp authority (critical CVE-2026-114713) plus 8 more fixes
changes.title: UnrealIRCd says UnrealIRCd 5 (EOL since 2023-07-01) is also affected by the critical bug; the workaround there is adding blacklist-module "labeled-response" to the config on all servers and restarting them.

changes.incidentTitle: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN: SAML / MFA bypass via alternate auth (CVE-2026-19868, CISA KEV) — SNWLID-2026-0014 batch
changes.title: SonicWall PSIRT publishes SNWLID-2026-0014; NVD receives CVE-2026-19868 (SSLVPN SAML/MFA bypass via alternate auth) and sibling SonicOS CVEs CVE-2026-82308, CVE-2026-107154, CVE-2026-107155, CVE-2026-19703, CVE-2026-77708, CVE-2026-77709. Affected: Gen7 7.3.3-7015 and older; Gen8 8.2.2-8015 and older.

changes.incidentTitle: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN: SAML / MFA bypass via alternate auth (CVE-2026-19868, CISA KEV) — SNWLID-2026-0014 batch
changes.title: CISA adds CVE-2026-19868 to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog (due 2026-11-20; known ransomware use Unknown). Required action: apply vendor mitigations per BOD 26-04.

changes.incidentTitle: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN: SAML / MFA bypass via alternate auth (CVE-2026-19868, CISA KEV) — SNWLID-2026-0014 batch
changes.title: BleepingComputer covers SNWLID-2026-0014 / CVE-2026-19868 SSL-VPN MFA bypass (exploitation already reflected via CISA KEV); reports Gen7 fixed in 7.3.4-7013 and Gen8 in 8.2.3-8015.

changes.incidentTitle: Microsoft Entra Device Registration elevation of privilege CVE-2026-109469 (CVSS 10.0) — already mitigated in the cloud service
changes.title: NVD lists CVE-2026-109469 as awaiting analysis with Microsoft's Critical 10.0 vector and exclusively-hosted-service tag.

changes.incidentTitle: Malicious Ruby gem strutil-core delivers testmetest/Shai-Hulud-descendant worm
changes.title: Socket publishes analysis tying strutil-core 1.0.1 to the testmetest worm (Miasma/Shai-Hulud descendant): install-time Bun runner, credential theft, AI-tool poisoning, conditional home-directory wiper on GitHub token revocation, and RubyGems injector identical to the worm's own module output.

changes.incidentTitle: Microsoft Entra Device Registration elevation of privilege CVE-2026-109469 (CVSS 10.0) — already mitigated in the cloud service
changes.title: Microsoft publishes CVE-2026-109469 for an Entra Device Registration elevation of privilege (Critical, CVSS 10.0); FAQ says the cloud service is already fully mitigated and customers need no action.

changes.incidentTitle: Apple Multiple Products: WebKit Pointer Authentication bypass (CVE-2024-27834) added to CISA KEV
changes.title: CISA adds CVE-2024-27834 to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog; federal agencies have until Nov 18 2026 to remediate.

changes.incidentTitle: Android November 2026 bulletin: critical Framework RCE with no user interaction (CVE-2026-58868)
changes.title: The Hacker News and SecurityWeek cover the critical no-interaction RCE and the broad November patch set (200+ issues in some counts).

changes.incidentTitle: Attackers hijacked cPGuard's update channel and backdoored about 2,950 Linux hosting servers
changes.title: SecurityWeek and Help Net Security report the supply-chain attack; BleepingComputer notes versions 5.88.12–5.88.19 and the data collected.

changes.incidentTitle: Attackers hijacked cPGuard's update channel and backdoored about 2,950 Linux hosting servers
changes.title: OPSSHIELD publishes its full disclosure: ~2,950 servers affected, ~7,900 billing accounts copied, attacker retrieved 32 loot files; advises update to 5.88.25+, credential rotation and IoC checks.

changes.incidentTitle: Android November 2026 bulletin: critical Framework RCE with no user interaction (CVE-2026-58868)
changes.title: Google publishes the Android Security Bulletin—November 2026. Most severe: CVE-2026-58868 critical Framework RCE with no user interaction; 2026-11-01 and 2026-11-05 patch levels defined.

changes.incidentTitle: Attackers hijacked cPGuard's update channel and backdoored about 2,950 Linux hosting servers
changes.title: Attacker uploads a fake cPGuard update with a stolen access key; between 02:08 and 03:20 UTC about 2,950 agents install it. OPSSHIELD revokes the key and publishes clean 5.88.26.

changes.incidentTitle: Attackers hijacked cPGuard's update channel and backdoored about 2,950 Linux hosting servers
changes.title: Attacker probes manage.opsshield.com, registers a fake customer trial, studies the agent, and by 22:58 UTC gains command execution on the billing and licensing server.

changes.incidentTitle: Malicious Ruby gem strutil-core delivers testmetest/Shai-Hulud-descendant worm
changes.title: RubyGems account jamnajiea publishes clean strutil-core 1.0.0 (02:19 UTC), then malicious 1.0.1 (04:05 UTC). Socket AI Scanner flags the payload 70 seconds later. RubyGems removes both versions about five hours after the malicious release (~08:52–09:13 UTC per Bitbison).

changes.incidentTitle: Malicious Ruby gem strutil-core delivers testmetest/Shai-Hulud-descendant worm
changes.title: Socket: PyPI sibling pystr-codec 0.1.0–0.1.2 appears, using the same paleasbest.top/v1/api collection endpoint (separate build from strutil-core).

changes.incidentTitle: Ruby 4.0.9, 3.4.12 and 3.3.13 fix Regexp compiler memory bugs behind GitLab's CVSS 10 RCEs
changes.title: Rapid7 merges a Metasploit exploit module for CVE-2026-97229 (GitLab RCE via the CI Lint endpoint), making a ready-made public exploit available. Patch GitLab and, for self-built installs, Ruby now.

changes.incidentTitle: Ruby 4.0.9, 3.4.12 and 3.3.13 fix Regexp compiler memory bugs behind GitLab's CVSS 10 RCEs
changes.title: CISA adds CVE-2026-97229 (GitLab CE/EE integer overflow or wraparound) to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, confirming exploitation in the wild. GitLab 19.4.2, 19.3.5 and 19.2.8 or later fix it.

changes.incidentTitle: Ruby 4.0.9, 3.4.12 and 3.3.13 fix Regexp compiler memory bugs behind GitLab's CVSS 10 RCEs
changes.title: Alpine Linux reopens its GitLab, upgraded to 19.3.7 after the rebuild; users must set a new password and accept new SSH host key fingerprints.

changes.incidentTitle: KeyDrift malware steals SD-WAN encryption keys from Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN controllers hacked through CVE-2026-20127
changes.title: Cisco Talos details KeyDrift, a malware framework UAT-11473 planted on SD-WAN controllers through CVE-2026-20127 to steal edge-router AES-256 key material, and releases Snort rules for its command-and-control traffic.

changes.incidentTitle: KeyDrift malware steals SD-WAN encryption keys from Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN controllers hacked through CVE-2026-20127
changes.title: Lumen says Volt Typhoon was exploiting CVE-2026-20127 by late 2025 and kept exploiting it after Cisco's February disclosure, per The Hacker News.

changes.incidentTitle: Ruby 4.0.9, 3.4.12 and 3.3.13 fix Regexp compiler memory bugs behind GitLab's CVSS 10 RCEs
changes.title: Alpine Linux reports an attacker tried to exploit CVE-2026-97229 on its GitLab on Oct 20 and 21, crashing workers 8 times; its upgrade to 19.3.6 did not fix it because its image used standard Ruby without GitLab's patch. It rebuilt GitLab, reset all passwords and replaced secret keys, and says self-built GitLab also needs Ruby 3.3.13, 3.4.12, 4.0.9 or later. No sign of tampering with aports, packages or releases.

changes.incidentTitle: Dahua cameras and recorders hijacked through Easy4IP P2P cloud access, CERT-UA warns
changes.title: The Record and The Hacker News report the CERT-UA warning; Hunt.io says the methods closely match CameraSwarm but there is no evidence it is the same attacker, and that removing rogue accounts is not enough without a firmware update.

changes.incidentTitle: Microsoft Authenticator for Android: any app could impersonate Teams or Outlook and get work-account tokens (AuthMask, CVE-2026-80097)
changes.title: Help Net Security reports the flaw and tells Android users to update to 6.2606.4246 or later.

changes.incidentTitle: Dahua cameras and recorders hijacked through Easy4IP P2P cloud access, CERT-UA warns
changes.title: CERT-UA warns of confirmed takeovers of Dahua IP cameras and recorders through Easy4IP P2P cloud access, with predictable serial numbers, weak passwords and CVE-2021-33044/33045 on old firmware. Signs of compromise: unknown accounts, unexpected config changes or text overlays on video, and DVRIP logins from 127.0.0.1 in the audit log.

changes.incidentTitle: Ruby 4.0.9, 3.4.12 and 3.3.13 fix Regexp compiler memory bugs behind GitLab's CVSS 10 RCEs
changes.title: Ruby releases 4.0.9, 3.4.12 and 3.3.13 with the upstream fixes: a double free when parsing fails after an alternation (#13332), an integer overflow in the compiled pattern size (#19020) and an overflow of internal IDs in patterns with many repeats (#16801). Ruby requested no CVEs of its own and says to track GitLab's IDs in scanners. Credit: Johan Carlsson (joaxcar) via GitLab's bug bounty; GitLab reported and coordinated.

changes.incidentTitle: Ruby 4.0.9, 3.4.12 and 3.3.13 fix Regexp compiler memory bugs behind GitLab's CVSS 10 RCEs
changes.title: Ruby 3.3 is in security maintenance and gets the Regexp fixes as an exception. 3.3.13 also updates the default resolv gem to 0.3.2, fixing CVE-2026-80212 and CVE-2026-80213.

changes.incidentTitle: Microsoft Authenticator for Android: any app could impersonate Teams or Outlook and get work-account tokens (AuthMask, CVE-2026-80097)
changes.title: Enclave publishes the AuthMask write-up showing a zero-permission app getting Teams' tokens from the Authenticator broker.

changes.incidentTitle: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator zero-day CVE-2026-114625 exploited in attacks
changes.title: CISA added CVE-2026-114625 to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, telling agencies to apply Arista's mitigations or stop using the product if mitigations are unavailable.

changes.incidentTitle: BlackX UEFI bootkit bypasses Secure Boot on patched Windows machines that never applied the Baton Drop revocation
changes.title: The Hacker News reports the campaign and the manual revocation gap.

changes.incidentTitle: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator zero-day CVE-2026-114625 exploited in attacks
changes.title: Arista disclosed CVE-2026-114625, an actively exploited SQL injection in on-prem VeloCloud Orchestrator, with fixes in 5.2.3.18, 6.1.3.10 and 6.4.2.12. Hosted VCO is already patched. Arista advised restricting the VCO web interface to admin networks, blocking 74.82.197.86 and 38.54.50.151, and preserving logs before remediating if compromise is suspected.

changes.incidentTitle: BlackX UEFI bootkit bypasses Secure Boot on patched Windows machines that never applied the Baton Drop revocation
changes.title: Kaspersky GReAT publishes its BlackX report: Baton Drop exploited on fully patched machines at Central Asian diplomatic organizations, likely APT41.

changes.incidentTitle: Ruby 4.0.9, 3.4.12 and 3.3.13 fix Regexp compiler memory bugs behind GitLab's CVSS 10 RCEs
changes.title: GitLab 19.5.1 and backports fix CVE-2026-110264 (CVSS 10.0, unauthenticated RCE from an integer overflow when compiling a crafted regex), affecting every CE/EE version from 7.0.

changes.incidentTitle: BlackX UEFI bootkit bypasses Secure Boot on patched Windows machines that never applied the Baton Drop revocation
changes.title: The "Windows Production PCA 2011" certificate expires; Kaspersky notes this does not stop vulnerable binaries from loading unless it is blocklisted.

changes.incidentTitle: Ruby 4.0.9, 3.4.12 and 3.3.13 fix Regexp compiler memory bugs behind GitLab's CVSS 10 RCEs
changes.title: GitLab 19.4.2 fixes CVE-2026-97229 (CVSS 10.0, unauthenticated RCE via a crafted CI/CD regex); Rapid7 shows the 19.4.1 repeat-bound check could be bypassed with an inline regex comment and built a working PoC against 19.4.1.

changes.incidentTitle: Ruby 4.0.9, 3.4.12 and 3.3.13 fix Regexp compiler memory bugs behind GitLab's CVSS 10 RCEs
changes.title: GitLab 19.4.1 fixes CVE-2026-89078 (double free in its regex parser, CVSS 9.9, authenticated RCE via CI/CD config) and CVE-2026-93577 (integer overflow in the regex compiler) by patching the Ruby it ships.
